race.description: Bodalla Bowling Club Town Plate Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: BOSCO (7) returned with a bang, scoring by 1.9L at Goulburn as the race favourite. This shapes similarly with Ellison's claim a big tick. The inside draw should see him closer to the front and if there's further improvement to come, he'll be hard to hold out. CANI CANCAN (2) missed fresh before a 1.8L defeat most recently at long odds at Kembla. Back to country level today is a big tick and the claim comes in handy. Likely to get back but her recent form suggests she can round them up. MARINE GIRL (10) stuck on well from the front over 1000m at Albury in a strong fresh effort. She's a second-up winner in the past and if she can work across from the draw, she'll be hard to hold out. ABSTRUSE (8) was too good at Nowra last time out when the ear muffs came off. Loy sticks and this shapes similarly. Can keep the ball rolling.
